source: live Gopher MCPTools catalog captured via ghost-fl-native-bridge probe

tools.name: get_session_context
tools.description: Returns a snapshot of the current FL Studio session: tempo, active channels, and modified mixer tracks (including names, volumes, panning, routing, loaded plugins, and send routing to other tracks).

tools.name: get_browser_names
tools.description: Use this tool to collect browser contents. CRITICAL PATHS TO USE: 'Plugin database' (Use this to find instruments or generators for the Channel Rack)

name.description: The exact directory path to search.

fullRecursive.description: Use 1 for deep search, 0 for direct children only.

tools.name: show_or_hide_window
tools.description: Sets the visibility state (shows or hides) of specified FL Studio window. Use for requests to open or close windows.

window_name.description: The name of the window. Valid names: {VALID_WINDOW_NAMES}

state.description: The desired visibility state. Valid states: 'show', 'hide', 'open', 'close'.

tools.name: get_highlight_names
tools.description: Returns a list of all currently valid UI elements that can be highlighted. Call this tool to get the exact string names required for the 'show_highlight' tool.

tools.name: show_highlight
tools.description: Highlights a toolbar icon or UI element. Use when user asks to be shown something.

tools.name: play
tools.description: Starts playback in FL Studio.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stops playback in FL Studio.

tools.name: get_tempo
tools.description: Gets the current project tempo in BPM.

tools.name: set_tempo
tools.description: Sets the project tempo.

bpm.description: The tempo in BPM to set the project to.

tools.name: list_channel_names
tools.description: Retrieves and lists all channels in the Channel Rack with their name and plugin.

tools.name: select_channels
tools.description: Selects, deselects, or toggles one or more channels in the Channel Rack.

tools.name: rename_channels
tools.description: Renames one or multiple channels in a single call.

tools.name: add_channel
tools.description: Use this tool to add a new instrument/generator to the channel rack. Effects are not for the channel rack. CRITICAL RULE: NEVER guess the plugin name. Before calling this tool, you MUST call get_browser_names with the path 'Plugin database' (fullRecursive=1).

tools.name: remove_channels
tools.description: Removes one or more channels from the Channel Rack.

tools.name: route_channels_to_mixer
tools.description: Routes one or more channels to a specified mixer track (useful for bus routing).

tools.name: get_channel_volumes
tools.description: Returns the current volume of one or more channels in normalized, percentage and dB form.

tools.name: set_channels_volume_db
tools.description: Sets volume for one or more channels in the Channel Rack using decibels (dB).

tools.name: set_channels_volume
tools.description: Sets the volume for one or more channels in the Channel Rack as a normalized value.

tools.name: set_channels_pan
tools.description: Sets the stereo pan for one or more channels in the Channel Rack.

tools.name: set_channels_colour
tools.description: Sets the color for one or more channels in the Channel Rack.

tools.name: mute_channels
tools.description: Mutes, unmutes, or toggles the mute state of one or more channels.

tools.name: solo_channels
tools.description: Solos, unsolos, or toggles the solo state of one or more channels.

tools.name: set_step_sequencer_step
tools.description: Sets a single step in the step sequencer for one or more channels.

tools.name: set_step_sequencer_pattern
tools.description: Sets a 16-step pattern for one or more channels.

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_pan
tools.description: Sets stereo pan for specified mixer tracks.

tools.name: get_mixer_tracks_volume
tools.description: Returns the current volume of one or more mixer tracks in normalized, percentage and dB form.

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_volume_db
tools.description: Sets volume level for specified mixer tracks using decibels (dB).

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_volume_percent
tools.description: Sets volume level for specified mixer tracks as a percentage.

tools.name: rename_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Renames one or multiple mixer tracks in a single call.

tools.name: add_effect
tools.description: Add an effect plugin to mixer track slot(s). NEVER guess the plugin name — always call get_browser_names first.

tools.name: remove_effect
tools.description: Remove effects from mixer track slot(s). This cannot be undone via script — the effect and its settings are lost.

tools.name: set_mixer_tracks_colour
tools.description: Sets the color of one or more mixer tracks.

tools.name: mute_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Mutes, unmutes, or toggles the mute state of one or more mixer tracks.

tools.name: solo_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Solos or unsolos one or more mixer tracks.

tools.name: reset_mixer_tracks
tools.description: Resets one or multiple mixer tracks to their default state.

tools.name: get_mixer_routing
tools.description: Returns the full send/receive routing matrix for all active mixer tracks.

tools.name: set_mixer_routing
tools.description: Sets up or removes a send from one mixer track to another.

tools.name: reset_mixer_routing
tools.description: Removes ALL send routing from one or more mixer tracks in a single call.

tools.name: open_piano_roll_for_channel
tools.description: Opens the Piano Roll for a specific channel.

tools.name: quantize_channel
tools.description: Quickly quantizes notes of the specified channel.

tools.name: get_playlist_track_names
tools.description: Returns a numbered list of all current Playlist track names.

tools.name: rename_playlist_tracks
tools.description: Renames one or multiple playlist tracks in a single call.

tools.name: set_playlist_tracks_colour
tools.description: Sets the color of a playlist track.

tools.name: get_plugin_parameter_list
tools.description: Lists all parameters for a specific plugin.

tools.name: get_plugin_parameter_value
tools.description: Gets the current value of a plugin parameter.

tools.name: set_plugin_parameter_value
tools.description: Sets the value of a plugin parameter.

tools.name: save_piano_roll_script
tools.description: Use this tool to save Piano Roll scripts.

tools.name: run_piano_roll_script
tools.description: Runs a Piano Roll script.
